name: diag_shared_training_queue_plan_01
command:
"""One approved frozen queue: pending training batches13..26, prior05..12 reserved.
Run its exact source through run_logged; no GPU, qsub or source science acceptance.
"""
import hashlib,json,math,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.gpu_shared_claim import canonical_hash,load_plan,reference,t02_identity,write_immutable
from src.tools.t01_partition_approved import audited_result
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve()
NAME='diag_shared_training_queue_plan_01'
PLAN='configs/shared_training_queue_01.json'
EXTERNAL={5:'t02_export_train_six_05',6:'t02_export_train_six_06',7:'t02_export_train_six_07_retry1',
          8:'t02_export_train_six_08',9:'t02_export_train_six_09_retry1',10:'t02_export_train_six_10',
          11:'t02_export_train_six_11',12:'t02_export_train_six_12'}
assert not (ROOT/'results'/(NAME+'.json')).exists()

def relative_ref(path):
 r=reference(ROOT/path);r['file']=str(Path(path));return r

def command(index,name):
 p='configs/t02_export_train_six_%02d.json'%index
 body=(ROOT/p).read_bytes()
 assert subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+p],cwd=ROOT)==body, 'Manifest differs from pushed-source checkout'
 sha=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
 return ['python3','-u','-m','src.tools.t02_export_parallel','--name',name,'--manifest',p,
         '--manifest-sha256',sha,'--concurrency','6','--timeout-seconds','1200',
         '--unit-timeout-seconds','900','--pair-timeout-seconds','660','--gate-timeout-seconds','180']

def unit(argv):
 manifest=argv[argv.index('--manifest')+1]
 row={'name':argv[argv.index('--name')+1],'producer_module':'src.tools.t02_export_parallel',
      'command':argv,'budget_group':'T02','priority':200,'gpus':1,'cpu_cores':12,
      'timeout_seconds':1200,'references':{'manifest':relative_ref(manifest)}}
 identity,keys=t02_identity(row,ROOT)
 row.update(identity=identity,claim_keys=keys,unit_id=canonical_hash(identity));return row

external=[]
for index,name in EXTERNAL.items():
 argv=command(index,name);matches=[]
 for folder in (ROOT/'logs/pbs').glob(name+'-*'):
  p,r=folder/'payload.json',folder/'submission.json'
  if not p.exists() or not r.exists():continue
  payload,receipt=json.loads(p.read_text()),json.loads(r.read_text())
  if payload.get('name')==name and receipt.get('returncode')==0:
   assert payload['command']==argv and payload['budget_group']=='T02' and payload['requested_gpu_count']==1
   matches.append({'unit':unit(argv),'payload_reference':relative_ref(p.relative_to(ROOT)),
                   'receipt_reference':relative_ref(r.relative_to(ROOT))})
 assert len(matches)==1, 'Require exactly one actual successful original receipt: '+name
 external+=matches
pending=[unit(command(index,'t02_export_train_six_%02d'%index)) for index in range(13,27)]
for row in pending:
 name=row['name']
 assert not (ROOT/'results'/(name+'.json')).exists()
 assert not any((ROOT/'logs/pbs').glob(name+'-*')), 'Pending original batch already submitted'
plan={'version':'shared_gpu_units_v1','queue_id':'training_exports_01',
      'priority_order':['G01','T02','E2Epilot'],'units':pending,'external_reservations':external,
      'scope':'Training exports only. Original05..12 all attempts reserved, including failed subsets. No G01 or pilot authorization.',
      'root_authorization':'38b15551: physics+compact smoke gates G01 separately; shared training export continues.'}
ref=write_immutable(ROOT/PLAN,plan);loaded,exact=load_plan(PLAN,ref['sha256'],root=ROOT);assert loaded==plan
# Observed whole original parent elapsed times, including their gate/cleanup.
# The last launch retains its full original1200s grant rather than replacing it
# with a point estimate. Earlier waves use observed maximum +30% planning only.
observed=[];sources=[]
for index in range(5,11):
 name=EXTERNAL[index];data,source=audited_result('results/'+name+'.json')
 assert data['_meta'].get('end') and data['metrics']['all_units_ended'] and data['metrics']['cleanup_errors']==[]
 elapsed=data['_meta']['duration_sec'];assert isinstance(elapsed,(float,int)) and elapsed>0
 observed.append({'name':name,'duration_seconds_observed':elapsed,'exit_code':data['_meta']['exit_code'],
                  'source':source})
 sources.append(source)
maximum=max(row['duration_seconds_observed'] for row in observed)
wave_estimate=math.ceil(maximum*1.3)
waves=math.ceil(len(pending)/4)
pack_timeout=180+(waves-1)*wave_estimate+1200+45
single_timeout=180+1200+45
planning={'basis':observed,'observed_max_parent_seconds':maximum,'earlier_wave_estimate_seconds':wave_estimate,
          'estimate_rule':'ceil(max actual original parent duration *1.30), planning only; no throughput/result claim',
          'four_gpu_waves_upper_population':waves,'final_unit_original_grant_seconds':1200,
          'per_card_gate_grant_seconds':180,'parent_cleanup_seconds':45,'pbs_cleanup_seconds':30,
          'four_gpu_parent_seconds':pack_timeout,'four_gpu_pbs_seconds':pack_timeout+30,
          'single_gpu_parent_seconds':single_timeout,'single_gpu_pbs_seconds':single_timeout+30}
metrics={'status':'immutable_training_only_queue_ready','plan_reference':exact,'planning':planning,
         'pending_original_batches':list(range(13,27)),'reserved_original_batches':list(range(5,13)),
         'full_T02_acceptance':False,'cache_or_training_authorized':False,'errors':[]}
(ROOT/'results'/(NAME+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'config':{'name':NAME,'scope':plan['scope']},'metrics':metrics,'sources':sources},indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print('SHARED_TRAINING_QUEUE_PLAN_JSON: '+json.dumps(plan,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(metrics,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
